name: @mercatus-liber/migrate-shopify
description: One-time Shopify-to-native migration tool (epic shopify-migration-import-tool). This is NOT @mercatus-liber/adapter-shopify, which is a live wrapper that proxies catalog reads/writes through Shopify's API forever -- this package reads a merchant's existing Shopify store exactly once and writes the result into Mercatus Liber's own native persistence through the real CatalogService/MarketingCatalogService/InventoryAdapter, so a merchant can actually leave Shopify. Dry-run by default; idempotent (safe to re-run) by construction. Orders/customers and images/media migration are explicitly out of scope for this first pass -- see this package's README.
